news.subject: Choir News
news.html:
Hello BBC Choir!

CHOIR REHEARSAL TIME CHANGE - Remember that this Sunday, Oct. 25 is the Lord's Supper and we will have practice from 4:45 to 5:15 in the chapel.  We will be back in the auditorium on Nov. 1 at 5:00pm.

PRACTICE TRACKS for "His Life For Mine"

Check your email later today (10/19) for practice tracks for "His Life for Mine."

FALL REVIVAL 2027 - Pastor would like for the choir to sing for the Monday-Wednesday services for the revival next fall.  We would sing songs that we know well that would need very little prep.  I had been thinking in that direction and agreed with Pastor that it would be a great addition to the revival.  I wanted to let you know the plan now so we can all plan accordingly.

Thank you for your faithfulness!
